$comment: No $id on purpose: every Rulebook schema is addressed by its file location (docs/reference/naming.md section 6).
title: Rulebook change set
description: A change set the dashboard cart submits through the rulebook-change issue form: overrides to set or remove and quarantined ids to release. Whether an id exists in the catalog, a slug in the settings, and whether two changes repeat the same op, id and selectors is checked by the workflow that applies it (WP15). See docs/dashboard.md section 6.

diagnosticId.description: A diagnostic id: two or three capital letters, four digits, an optional lowercase i (PTE0011, AL0432, LC0089i).

ruleAction.description: A rule action. Default is not valid for a rule.

slug.description: A level or stage slug: the lowercased name from the settings.

selector.description: ["*"] for every level or stage, or a non-empty list of distinct slugs. Arrays only; "default" is a valid stage slug.

set.description: Write or replace the override entry of this id with exactly these selectors.

justification.description: Why the organization overrides this rule; stored in the override entry. Optional (D37).

remove.description: Delete the override entry of this id with exactly these selectors.

release.description: Remove this id from quarantine.<stage>.json of every listed stage.

note.description: Optional. Becomes the first paragraph of the pull request body.
